card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 12 That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 12 That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone 12 series Missing sensors TG0B/TG0V = battery; diode-check I2C2_SMC_SDA_1V8 / I2C2_SMC_SCL_1V8 and look for missing R2472, R2473, R2475 near the battery connector.
Prs0, Mic1 or Eiger in Missing sensors point to the charging port flex.

procedure: TG0B/TG0V: battery swap, data pins, R2472/R2473/R2475.
Prs0/Mic1/Eiger: known-good charge port flex, diode-check FPC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
